items.rationale: The police report is required under 2.3.3, but its translation is expressly excluded by 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f).
Working materials billed alongside the translation are excluded under 7.1.8(e)–(f), even when separately itemised.

The armed taking is covered under 2.3, but 7.1.9 excludes the upgrade and 4.4 caps the unscheduled watch at €2,500. Allocating the single €150 event deductible rateably across the €3,000 covered loss assigns €125 to the watch, leaving €2,375.

The approximately €900 taken is capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3; the combined watch and cash loss is below the €5,000 away-from-home limit. The cash line bears €25 of the single event deductible on a rateable allocation, leaving €475.
The sunglasses were mislaid later, not taken in the robbery, so they are excluded under 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.5.
Shipping is expressly excluded by 7.1.8(b), even when billed on the same statement as covered property.
